output: Hypothesis: The first principal component (PC1) of the forms of capital during the Middle Neolithic (3400-3000 BCE) is more negative compared to the Younger Neolithic (2900-2300 BCE), indicating a different pattern or intensity of capital forms during these two periods. This difference is statistically significant, as evidenced by the mean PC1 values of -800.0 for the Middle Neolithic and -200.0 for the Younger Neolithic.
